Created the scratch crate:

- [Cargo.toml](/tmp/exposed-weldrs-resolution-20261009/capture-converter/Cargo.toml)
- [main.rs](/tmp/exposed-weldrs-resolution-20261009/capture-converter/src/main.rs)

Preflight validates UUIDs, source IDs, schemas, and duplicate destinations before writing. Conversion removes only `member_id` and publishes a UUID-keyed audit map.

Assumes nonempty partitions, canonical lowercase UUID filenames, and unchanged input during conversion. Outputs must be fresh paths outside the input directory. Failed conversion may leave partial scratch outputs.

Formatted with rustfmt. No build or execution performed.
